classification.difficultyReason: Select the appropriate speed, distance or time relationship in each part and coordinate it with conversion between minutes and hours.

content.prompt: Joe walks every morning to keep fit.

children.label: a
children.prompt: If he walks a distance of $10$ km at an average speed of $6$ km/h, how long, in minutes, does his morning walk take him?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Time taken}&=\frac{\text{distance travelled}}{\text{speed}}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{10}{6}\text{ h}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{5}{3}\times60\text{ min}\\\text{Time taken}&=100\text{ min}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: If he walks a distance of $7$ km and it takes him $80$ minutes, what is his average speed, in km/h?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Time taken}&=\frac{80}{60}\text{ h}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{4}{3}\text{ h}\\\text{Average speed}&=\frac{\text{distance travelled}}{\text{time taken}}\\\text{Average speed}&=7\div\frac{4}{3}\text{ km/h}\\\text{Average speed}&=7\times\frac{3}{4}\text{ km/h}\\\text{Average speed}&=5\frac{1}{4}\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: If he walks at an average speed of $5$ km/h for $140$ minutes, how far does he walk?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Time taken}&=\frac{140}{60}\text{ h}\\\text{Time taken}&=\frac{7}{3}\text{ h}\\\text{Distance travelled}&=\text{speed}\times\text{time taken}\\\text{Distance travelled}&=5\times\frac{7}{3}\text{ km}\\\text{Distance travelled}&=11\frac{2}{3}\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
